title: Brand personality / driver header
slide_intent: Make personality visible through an operational action so the brand is associated with real work.
strategic_value: The close view of the driver at the controls can support DB’s responsible and active stance.
demonstration: A cropped driver and control desk fill the header above a red sleeper strip.
practical_value: Use a work detail to introduce personality before describing it in words.

content_islands.name: Driver detail
content_islands.spec: Fill the header with the driver’s arm, uniform and control equipment.

content_islands.name: Sleeper edge
content_islands.spec: Place the red sleeper motif on the lower edge of the photograph.

reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph and sleeper motif connect a working railway scene to the brand.
